future_research_protocol: Read this ledger, screenshot evidence matrix, scenario inputs, completed replay report and newest checkpoints FIRST.
Check previous captures before asking questions; request only an outstanding precise field. Never ask for the same complete screenshot bundle again.
Never repeat the existing 6048 scenario-year replays without a preregistered distinct comparison, data/code change, or reproducibility requirement with clear input hashes.
Keep 2022/23 training, 2024 previously examined development, and sealed/unread 2025 distinct.
Distinguish snapshot evidence from actual historical GatesFX quotes and fills; profitability rankings remain provisional/unranked until broker conditions verified.
No live trading, production deploy, 2025 reads, branch merge, broker credential handling or claims of qualified strategies.
Apply user confirmed 1C 2C 3A 4A 5A 6A research preferences; only send missing-data request when an evidence check says the field is unavailable.
Do not ask account currency again; user explicitly confirmed USD. Treat as user-reported, distinct from an authenticated account export.
The user has both TradeLocker and MT5 access; use MT5 broker-server history/export and broker-issued TradeLocker reports when available; never assume TradeLocker has native CSV history export.
Never run a shared-capital simulation; separate $1,000 USD starts are required for each tested independent scenario.
If no historical GatesFX source exists, allow public-price models with stress ranges but prohibit definitive broker rankings or actual-fill claims.
